Payload 4 support. Payload 3 users stay on `0.x`.

## Breaking changes

- Requires Payload 4.0.0-canary.38, Next.js 16.4+ and Node.js 24.15+.
- Renamed options: `metadata` → `info`, `specEndpoint` → `path`, `interactiveAuth.endpoint` → `interactiveAuth.path`, docs UI `specEndpoint` → `specURL`. Old names throw at startup.
- `securityWhen` is now `security`. It returns `'public'`, `'secured'`, a security requirement or `undefined`.
- `custom.openapi.security` takes `'public'` or `'secured'` instead of `true` or `false`.
- `filters.excludeWhen` is removed. Pass the function to `filters.excludeOperations` instead.
- `excludeOperations` and `security` now also apply to custom, jobs and system endpoints.
- Extension `transform` gets one object (`{ doc, payload, options }`). If it throws, the spec request fails.
- `servers` no longer comes from the `Host` header. Use `servers`, `serverURL` or `trustedHosts`.
- Payload 4 routes: access is `GET /api/access`, and root endpoints live under `/api` (`/api/health`).
- Payload 4 turns versions on by default, so version endpoints show up unless you set `versions: false`.
- `payload-jobs-stats` is hidden unless `includeSystem` is on.

See the [upgrade guide](https://payload-plugin-openapi.seshuk.im/v1/upgrade-guide) for details.

```ts
// 0.x
openapi({
  metadata: { title, version },
  specEndpoint: '/spec.json',
  securityWhen: ({ slug }) => (slug === 'feed' ? true : undefined),
  filters: { excludeWhen: ({ path }) => path.includes('/internal/') },
})

// v1
openapi({
  info: { title, version },
  path: '/spec.json',
  security: ({ slug }) => (slug === 'feed' ? 'public' : undefined),
  filters: { excludeOperations: [({ path }) => path.includes('/internal/')] },
})
```

## New

- New Payload 4 endpoints: validate, upload instructions, file download, API key reveal and document access. Validate follows `access.validate`, and `custom.openapi.security` accepts a `validate` key.
- `access` on `openapi()`, `scalar()` and `swaggerUi()` limits who can see the spec and the docs.
- `servers` and `trustedHosts` set the base URLs.
- `info` takes the full OpenAPI Info Object, and `info.description` can be localized. The docs page title is `info.title`.
- `interactiveAuth.collection` picks the login collection.
- `transform` can be async and gets `payload` and `options`.
- `custom.openapi` is typed for collections, globals and fields.
- Scalar and Swagger UI load pinned versions with SRI.
- Folders and tags are documented.
- Anonymous usage telemetry. Turn it off with `telemetry: false` or `DO_NOT_TRACK=1`.
- [Endpoints reference](https://payload-plugin-openapi.seshuk.im/v1/reference/endpoints) in the docs.

## Fixes

- After you log in on the docs page, requests sent from it include your token. The docs page also loads the spec from a custom `path`.
- Version, restore, jobs and staged upload endpoints are secured when they should be, not public.
- Request bodies match what Payload accepts: nested relationships are IDs, polymorphic ones are `{ relationTo, value }`, and read-only fields are left out.
- Write operations list every query param Payload reads, such as `depth`, `locale`, `draft`, `autosave` and `overrideLock`.
- Responses match Payload: create returns `201`, global update returns `{ message, result }`, and global restore returns `{ doc, message }`.
- Auth bodies follow `loginWithUsername`, and unlock is documented for every auth collection. With `disableLocalStrategy`, `me`, `logout`, `refresh-token` and `init` stay.
- OpenAPI 3.0 and 3.1 output is valid.
- `payload-kv`, `payload-llm-instructions` and `payload-query-presets` are hidden unless `includeSystem` is on.
- Joins over several collections require `relationTo`.
- Interactive auth `expires_in` is in seconds.
